policies.title: Singapore citizens: home-country entry classification
policies.summary: Singapore citizens are classified as citizenship access rather than foreign visitor visa applicants.
conditions: The Immigration Act addresses Singapore visas as visas for non-citizens and separately provides a right-of-entry provision.
This citizenship classification does not establish the treatment of a foreign passport held by a dual Singapore citizen.
SGAC is a free arrival and health declaration, not a visa or ETA. Submit it within three days before arrival unless a published exception applies.
SGAC is not required for travellers transiting or transferring without seeking immigration clearance; Singapore residents entering through land checkpoints also have the stated exemption.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: prior Singapore e-Visa required
policies.summary: The listed ordinary-passport nationalities require a valid Singapore entry visa before travel; ICA/MFA guidance provides a pre-travel e-Visa procedure.
conditions: This normalizes only ordinary nationality passports. ICA's master list is expressed as travel documents; separate diplomatic, official, service, special, refugee, alien, identity, temporary, and travel-permit rules are not flattened into this cohort.

ICA says a listed travel document requires a valid Singapore entry visa. The MFA describes an approved SAVE application as an e-Visa, so this is an electronically issued prior-visa route, not a visa on arrival or ETA.

Application may be made through a Singapore local contact with Singpass, an ICA strategic partner, a Singapore Overseas Mission, or its authorised visa agent; ICA does not accept visa applications at immigration counters.
A local contact or authorised agent may print the approved e-Visa. Approval and border admission are discretionary.
The ICA list separately requires a visa for a Palestinian Authority passport; this policy maps that named passport document to PS but does not establish other Palestinian travel-document treatment.

The master list separately identifies refugee documents, alien passports, a UAE temporary passport, HKSAR DOI, Macao SAR Travel Permit, and PRC Travel Document; none is represented by an ISO ordinary-passport code here.

For AM, AZ, BY, GE, IN, KZ, KG, MD, RU, TJ, TM, UA and UZ, a conditional 96-hour VFTF may replace the prior-visa requirement only for qualifying transit described by ICA; it is not an ordinary visitor waiver.
Admission remains subject to ICA assessment at the checkpoint; a Singapore visa is pre-entry permission and does not determine the Visit Pass duration.
All travellers need an individually issued travel document; except Singapore passport holders, passports must have at least six months' validity.
SGAC is a free arrival and health declaration, not a visa or ETA. Submit it within three days before arrival unless a published exception applies.
SGAC is not required for travellers transiting or transferring without seeking immigration clearance; Singapore residents entering through land checkpoints also have the stated exemption.

application.label: ICA SAVE visa e-Service
application.processingTime: ICA states three working days excluding submission day; some cases take longer.
steps: Confirm the travel document is visa-required and use the normal social or business visitor route only.
Have a qualified Singapore local contact submit through SAVE, use an ICA strategic partner, or follow the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission's authorised-agent procedure.
Apply within 30 days before arrival as ICA advises and provide the required application form, photograph, passport biodata page, and any requested supporting documents.
Travel only after approval and use the e-Visa copy produced through the e-Service; complete SGAC separately before arrival.

policies.title: People's Republic of China ordinary passports: 30-day visa exemption
policies.summary: Holders of ordinary PRC passports are exempt from Singapore visa requirements for stays up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to ordinary passports issued by the PRC for stays up to 30 days.
Diplomatic, public-affairs, and service PRC passports have separate 30-day treatment; other PRC travel documents still need a visa.
This does not cover the PRC Travel Document, HKSAR Document of Identity, or Macao SAR Travel Permit.
Admission remains subject to ICA assessment at the checkpoint; a Singapore visa is pre-entry permission and does not determine the Visit Pass duration.
All travellers need an individually issued travel document; except Singapore passport holders, passports must have at least six months' validity.
SGAC is a free arrival and health declaration, not a visa or ETA. Submit it within three days before arrival unless a published exception applies.
SGAC is not required for travellers transiting or transferring without seeking immigration clearance; Singapore residents entering through land checkpoints also have the stated exemption.
